nemecky_brod.name: Battle of Německý Brod
nemecky_brod.terrain: Height at Habry, frozen Sázava. Ice became deadly trap.
nemecky_brod.outcome: Crushing victory. 2nd Crusade ends in complete debacle.

casualties.enemy: Thousands dead in field + in city

nemecky_brod.aftermath: Crushing victory. 2nd Crusade ends in complete debacle.
nemecky_brod.significance: Avenged massacre of Hussites at Kutná Hora. 548 knights drowned under ice. City empty for years.

quotes.text: The town of Německý Brod falls and all perish... at least one thousand five hundred people.
[The massacre was] a great sin on the souls of all Hussites involved.

trivia: January 11 Žižka was KNIGHTED
548 knights drowned under ice on Sázava
City was EMPTY FOR YEARS - wolves ran through streets
Massacre was revenge for murder of Hussites at Kutná Hora

most.name: Battle of Most

enemySide.strength: Saxon army + Most militia + Catholic nobility

most.terrain: Slope of Hněvín hill with castle. Hussites attacked UPHILL without wagon fort - MISTAKE.
most.outcome: HUSSITE DEFEAT. Weakening of Jan Želivský's position.
most.aftermath: HUSSITE DEFEAT. Weakening of Jan Želivský's position.
most.significance: FIRST major Hussite defeat. Erased from textbooks - didn't fit image of invincible Hussites.

quotes.text: [Vavřinec of Březová provides description but was not Želivský supporter - may have exaggerated defeat]

trivia: FIRST major Hussite defeat
Erased from textbooks - didn't fit image of invincible Hussites
Virgin Mary became protector of Most
Žižka WAS NOT PRESENT - recovering from going blind

usti.name: Battle of Ústí nad Labem
usti.terrain: Gentle hill with plateau. Double line of wagon fort.
usti.significance: LAST BATTLE where cavalry frontally attacked wagon fort. Piccolomini wrongly attributed victory to dead Žižka.

quotes.text: And the stream which flows through Ústí was entirely thick and bloody from the great slaughter of men and horses.
Czechs should remember that the Lord God gave them victory at Ústí...

trivia: Piccolomini WRONGLY attributed victory to dead Žižka
FIRST great battle of Prokop the Great as commander
14 counts and barons fell
LAST BATTLE where cavalry frontally attacked wagon fort

tachov.name: Battle of Tachov

enemySide.composition: FIRST use of own wagon fort by crusaders

tachov.terrain: Area around Stříbro and Tachov. Indecisive - crusaders fled.
tachov.outcome: Without battle - crusaders fled! 4th Crusade ends in debacle.
tachov.aftermath: Without battle - crusaders fled! 4th Crusade ends in debacle.
tachov.significance: Crusades halted for 4 years. Demonstrated complete demoralization of crusader armies.

quotes.text: And when the Taborites approached within three miles, said princes fled to Bavaria...
The cardinal tore down banners, threw them before Germans on ground and fiercely berated them.
I see not whom to flee from, I see no enemy!

trivia: Crusaders used own wagon fort - ineffective
Cardinal Beaufort recruited English archers only in 1429 - they never reached Bohemia, diverted to France
'I see not whom to flee from, I see no enemy!' - sarcastic remark by knight Kamrovec
Crusades halted for 4 years

nisa.name: Battle of Nysa (Silesia)
nisa.terrain: Before city walls. Surprise and rapid maneuver.
nisa.outcome: Crushing victory. Cities surrender or pay tribute.
nisa.aftermath: Crushing victory. Cities surrender or pay tribute.
nisa.significance: Part of first 'Beautiful Ride' into Silesia. Only major battle of Silesian raid - cities then surrendered without fight.

quotes.text: They arrived before Neisse quite unexpectedly... The peasants immediately fled.

trivia: Part of first 'BEAUTIFUL RIDE' into Silesia
2,000 defenders drowned in Nysa river
Duke of Legnica-Brzeg cowardly fled
Only major battle of Silesian raid - cities then surrendered without fight
nisa.reliability: Low - less documented, most details reconstructed

domazlice.name: Battle of Domažlice
domazlice.location: Between Domažlice and Kdyně, at Baldov hill

hussiteSide.composition: Combined unions of Taborites, Orphans and Praguers

enemySide.composition: 9,000 wagons in Hussite style, hundreds of guns

domazlice.terrain: Road to Domažlice, Všeruby pass. Pass - narrow bottleneck for fleeing.
domazlice.outcome: Legendary victory. End of military solution, negotiations at Basel Council.
domazlice.aftermath: Legendary victory. End of military solution, negotiations at Basel Council.
domazlice.significance: Peak of Hussite glory. Largest crusade fled without daring to fight. CARDINAL'S HAT lost in flight became symbol.

quotes.text: When that destructive nation approached us... seized with such horror we all in sudden dread; there our strength vanishes and counsel flees with hope...
...already resounded the clatter of wagon march and song of whole camp loudly Who are God's warriors...

trivia: CARDINAL'S HAT lost in flight - symbol of victory
Choral 'Ktož jsú boží bojovníci' sounded before battle
Cesarini later advocated diplomatic negotiation
Crusaders fled without daring to fight

lipany.name: Battle of Lipany
lipany.location: Between Hřiby and Lipská hora, 40 km E of Prague
lipany.terrain: Lipská hora (more advantageous for radicals), plain at Hřiby. TWO ARMIES IN WAGON FORTS facing each other.
lipany.outcome: Crushing defeat of radicals. End of field armies. Compactata at Jihlava 1436.
lipany.aftermath: Crushing defeat of radicals. End of field armies. Compactata at Jihlava 1436.
lipany.significance: End of radical Hussitism. Fratricidal battle where Hussites defeated Hussites. 'Czechs can be defeated only by Czechs.'

quotes.text: Up, up, at them, they're already fleeing!
quotes.source: Call of radicals - Bartošek of Drahonice

quotes.text: And there said lords pursued them so rapidly still striking them that they ran between their wagons and right there on wagons killed both priests Prokop...
Czechs can be defeated only by Czechs.
Who stops here, ponder where leads discord of nation.

trivia: George of Poděbrady (future king) participated at 14 years
700-900 prisoners BURNED in barns
Body of Prokop the Great NEVER FOUND
Jan Roháč of Dubá resisted until 1437 - then executed
lipany.reliability: High - many sources including Bartošek of Drahonice

horice.name: Battle of Hořice
horice.location: Gothard hill (357 m), SE of Hořice in Jičín region

enemySide.composition: Cavalry formations of Catholic Czech nobility

horice.terrain: Gothard hill. Wagon fort on hilltop.
horice.outcome: Crushing Orebite victory. Showed strength of eastern Bohemian Hussites.
horice.aftermath: Crushing Orebite victory. Showed strength of eastern Bohemian Hussites.
horice.significance: FIRST INTERNAL CONFLICT OF HUSSITES. Eastern Bohemia = cradle of Hussite commanders.

quotes.text: When Žižka rode close to them near Hořice, he attacked them... that he captured several hundred of them.
Lord Čeněk with some lords gathered against Žižka and they had battle together and there Žižka defeated those lords, captured and killed many of them.

trivia: Čeněk of Wartenberg - notorious TURNCOAT (changed sides 4-5 times)
Diviš Bořek of Miletínek - later victor at Lipany
FIRST INTERNAL CONFLICT OF HUSSITES
Eastern Bohemia = cradle of Hussite commanders

malesov.name: Battle of Malešov
malesov.location: At Malešov fortress, 6 km S of Kutná Hora, valley of Bohynka stream

enemySide.composition: Prague union + Plzeň landfrieden + moderate Utraquists

malesov.terrain: Valley at Malešov - narrow passage. Žižka blocked passage with wagon fort.
malesov.outcome: Brilliant victory of blind commander. BLOODIEST battle of Hussite Wars.
malesov.aftermath: Brilliant victory of blind commander. BLOODIEST battle of Hussite Wars.
malesov.significance: Peak of Žižka's career - blind defeated superior numbers. Coalition attempted ASSASSINATION of Žižka. Žižka died 4 months later (October 11, 1424).

quotes.text: Item, Praguers shat themselves with wheat at Malešov, for all Praguers were girded with wheat as sign.
...Žižka entered the valley because he knew that it is a gorge in which enemies absolutely cannot deploy their ranks... killed 3,000 Praguers...
In the year of Our Lord 1424 Žižka with his men defeated Praguers in battle and took from them many wagons with guns; three hundred Prague citizens fell.

trivia: WAGONS WITH STONES - legend or reality? Predecessor of tank tactics
Peak of Žižka's career - blind defeated superior numbers
Coalition attempted ASSASSINATION of Žižka
Žižka died 4 months later (October 11, 1424)
